claims.statement: Our constraint equals the CMM2026 k=1 Lambda=0 differential operator multiplied by h^2 exp(-2x)/4 under U=-exp(-x-tau)/4, V=exp(-x+tau)/4, kappa=h/2 in matched coordinate units.
Clock, positive-frequency selection, inner product, state data, global domain and observables are not identified by the operator transformation alone.

Current main computes inverse-radius and intrinsic-sphere diagnostics, not a full 4D Kretschmann operator. Continuum divergence depends on asymptotic assumptions; the uniform remainder bound is absent.
Classical massless specialization of CHS2023 full-momentum ansatz integrates to I proportional to (a+b mu^2)^-4, unlike our exponential angular ansatz.
CHS2023 appendix A matches initial macroscopic quantities while varying distribution shape; Brizuela2014 explicitly proposes the same three-way classical/quantum comparison strategy.
Failure to find an exactly identical threshold coefficient and regulator audit is not evidence of originality.
